-- Returns True only when `path` stays inside the base directory after
-- normalization: no absolute paths, and no `..` that climbs above the base.
is_contained(path: str) -> bool =
  ex is_contained("a.txt") == True
  ex is_contained("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_contained("../x") == False
  ex is_contained("sub/../../x") == False
  ex is_contained("/etc/passwd") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for p in parts
    if p == "" or p == "."
      continue
    if p == ".."
      if depth == 0
        return False
      depth -= 1
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Returns the text of the file at `path` inside the `notes` directory,
-- or "" if the path escapes `notes` or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_public("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  if is_contained(path) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(path) else ""
    text
